Overview
I am a dual title PhD student in Sociology and Gerontology. I am also a graduate certificate student in The Methodology Center. I am demographer seeking to understand the role of stratification and inequality in shaping health outcomes. I am also interested in quantitative methodology specializing in causal inference and longitudinal data analysis.
I am firmly committed to open science and reproducibility. Thus, I freely share the data, code, and replication files for all of my research projects.
The various pages on this site contain:

Description of my background and research
My CV
Copies of my published articles along with abstracts, replication files, online appendices, etc.
